manifest.help_text: Manifest containing paths to fastq files. with headers ID,R1,R2.

stb_file.help_text: Supply the sample‑to‑bin (STB) mapping file. Required when using a custom sourmash database.

genome_dir.help_text: Supply the directory containing reference genomes. Required when using a custom sourmash database.

sourmash_db.help_text: Supply the sourmash zip database. If custom, also set genome_dir, genomes_file_ext, and stb_file.

genomes_file_ext.help_text: File extension for reference genomes (e.g. .fna, .fna.gz .fasta, .fasta.gz, .fa, .fa.gz). Required when using a custom sourmash database.
